narrative.overview: RouteLab presents model allocation as a reviewable engineering decision. Editorial judgment and operational density share one material system of paper, ink, rules, ledgers, and decision marks.
keyCharacteristics: Distinct voices for judgment, operation, and evidence

rules.name: The Scarce Signal Rule
rules.body: Vermilion and green identify decisions; neither becomes decorative atmosphere.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use serif for judgment, sans for operation, and mono only for evidence metadata.

rules.name: The Registered Paper Rule
rules.body: Offset shadows indicate a physical decision artifact; ordinary data rows remain flat.

dos: Expose evidence, decision state, and runtime behavior together.
Use current product screenshots as factual proof.
Keep dense operational tables horizontally scrollable.
donts: Do not use glows, glassmorphism, or gradient text.
Do not turn every content group into a rounded floating card.
Do not fabricate approval or performance outcomes.
